title: Loop Is the Marble Calendar That Never Runs Out of Pages
reason: Loop uses two concentric rotating marble rings to create a tactile perpetual calendar. It turns daily date-setting into a reusable physical ritual and makes use of a durable natural material without disposable pages.
creator: Elif Karaca

title: Discover Your Poetic Journey Through Time With Calen-bar
reason: Calen-Bar is a perpetual calendar that uses a movable rubber band and metal weight as the date indicator. Its direct manipulation creates a clear daily interaction while avoiding annual replacement.
creator: Yukimasa Hirota

title: iF Design - Minimal PerpetualCalendar
reason: Minimal PerpetualCalendar reveals only the relevant dates through a sliding card mechanism. It improves monthly operation, removes the need to hide unused dates, and can be reused indefinitely.
creator: T3design / TRADE WORKS

title: iF Design - Casovnik Interactive Wall Calendar
reason: Casovnik links Google Calendar events to small electromagnet-controlled balls on an analog wall display. Upcoming events gain a physical position and movement, combining scheduling utility with a clear interactive mechanism.
creator: Janzey Marinc / Matic Lenarsic / Jernej Kozelj
